text:
maria: Heads-up — after rolling runtime v2.7.1 to ~20% traffic (us-west) at 08:02 UTC we're seeing p95 jump from ~90ms -> ~210ms and p99 spikes to ~420-480ms on /v1/generate for long-sequence workloads. Alerts started at ~08:14.

aditya: I see the alert page. Any customer-facing impact yet?

maria: Two customers reported higher latency, but no errors. Canary only so far. I grabbed per-route breakdown: the regression is concentrated on routes that hit seq_len >= 512 and use kv-cache.

sasha: Is this tied to the kernel-selector rollout in v2.7.1?

deploy-bot: Deploy v2.7.1 canary started by aditya at 2026-03-17T08:02:07Z (traffic: 20%).

jun: Replayed synthetic workload against canary in staging with our long-prompt generator, reproduces p99 tails. I see intermittent stalls where token emission pauses ~200-400ms. Sampling shows kernel fallback events. Attaching log snippet: 

```
[2026-03-17T08:13:58Z] runtime: request_id=abc123 seq_len=1024 batch=1 selected_kernel=matmul_fast fallback=false elapsed_ms=12
[2026-03-17T08:14:01Z] runtime: request_id=def456 seq_len=1024 batch=1 selected_kernel=matmul_fallback fallback=true elapsed_ms=318
[2026-03-17T08:14:04Z] runtime: request_id=ghi789 seq_len=768 batch=1 selected_kernel=matmul_fast fallback=false elapsed_ms=15
```

eli: Quick hypothesis: commit 4f2a3b introduced a kernel-tuner heuristic that misclassifies some attention shapes and triggers an expensive fallback path for certain sequence & kv-cache patterns.

maria: Can we bisect between v2.6.9 and v2.7.1 to isolate the culprit? Also want to confirm whether kv-cache warming (cold vs warm) affects repro.

aditya: I started a quick git bisect locally. Repro script executed against each build. Steps I ran: 

```
git bisect start v2.7.1 v2.6.9
# ./test_perf.sh runs ~100 sample requests seq_len 512-1024 batch=1 and reports p95/p99
git bisect run ./test_perf.sh
# result: first bad commit found: 4f2a3b (runtime/kernel-tuner: add adaptive threshold)
```

sasha: Nice. test_perf.sh uses our synthetic sampler though — can we shadow real traffic to be sure? I'll spin a 10% shadow against the suspected commit.

jun: Shadow run confirmed: with 4f2a3b in the runtime, p95 ~200ms and p99 ~430ms for the customer workload sample. When I rebuild with that commit reverted, p95 drops to ~92ms p99 ~120ms in the same shadow window.

maria: Repro steps I followed (minimal):

1) export RUNTIME_KERNEL_DEBUG=1
2) curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<long prompt>","max_new_tokens":256}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'
3) Observe token emission stalls and kernel fallback logs as above.

eli: Additional observation: the stalls correlate with batch consolidation events (when tenant consolidation combines small concurrent requests) and only happen when kv-cache hit rate > 0. Could be an interaction between cache indexing and the new tuner thresholds.

aditya: Mitigation options: 1) Pause canary (reduce to 0%), 2) Hotfix revert of 4f2a3b to restore prior tuner, 3) Add defensive cap so selector never chooses the fallback for seq_len > 512 until we validate. Which path preferred?

sasha: Customer impact is limited but noticeable; I'd prefer a revert + smaller canary to validate fix.

maria: Oncall agrees — reduce canary and roll back the tuner change. Sasha, can you open the rollback PR and coordinate infra?

sasha: On it. Creating rollback PR now and will coordinate with infra to run a 10% canary post-rollback.

```
# quick rollback steps
git checkout -b rollback/kernel-tuner-4f2a3b
git revert 4f2a3b --no-edit
bazel build //services/runtime:runtime_binary
```

jun: I've also put together a reproducible harness that replays sampled customer traces with exact kv-cache patterns. I'll hand it to adi/runtime-team for unit tests.

aditya: I'll open a follow-up PR to add a selector-telemetry flag and improved unit tests. Also adding a runtime knob to disable the new heuristic without rebuilding (ENV KERNEL_TUNER_ENABLED=false).

maria: Action items: 
- sasha: PR + rollback canary to 0% then deploy reverted binary at 08:55 UTC.
- jun: push repro harness and example traces to the runtime repo.
- aditya: feature-flag the tuner and add tests.
- eli: run extended shadow runs tomorrow for seq_len 256-2048 combos.
- maria: prep customer comms for affected tenants and update support ticket.

deploy-bot: Rollback to v2.6.9 initiated by sasha at 2026-03-17T08:55:12Z.

maria: Thanks everyone — please add short notes to the incident doc and assign postmortem. We should also add an automated bisect job that runs the perf-harness on PRs touching kernel selection.

aditya: Agreed. Opening follow-up ticket: RUNTIME-5123 (perf-bisect automation).

sasha: Rollback succeeded, canary now at 0%. Monitoring shows p95 back to baseline within two minutes. :white_check_mark:

maria: Closing the escalation for now. Postmortem timeline assigned.
